Subject: Finlytics evaluation — next steps & kickoff

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the time today — really enjoyed the discussion about where Finlytics is trying to use LLMs to improve customer support summarization and fraud triage. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you into an evaluation as soon as possible:

- Recap from discovery: primary use cases are support ticket summarization (short-form) and a fraud triage reranker for alerts. Success criteria we heard: 90%+ acceptable summaries in our eval set and precision uplift of 15% on triage reranking vs baseline.
- What we propose: 2-week evaluation with a kickoff meeting to align on trial plan, success criteria, and the prompt set / eval harness. We'll run a small labeled prompt set and surface token and latency metrics via the Redwood Console.

Proposed kickoff slots:
- Wed, Feb 18 — 10:00 AM PT
- Thu, Feb 19 — 2:00 PM PT

Agenda (60m): 1) Introductions + roles, 2) Evaluation plan & metrics, 3) Prompt set and data requirements, 4) Technical deep dive (networking, test environment), 5) Next steps.

I've attached a draft eval plan for your review: Finlytics-Eval-Plan-v1.pdf

Can you confirm availability for either slot and who from your side should attend? Also let me know if you have any security or compliance questions up front and whether you prefer a hosted sandbox or a Private deployment trial.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0134

Attachment: Finlytics-Eval-Plan-v1.pdf
